services.name: Campsite
services.desc: There are two private ponds on the property. No fishing license needed. The east pond and the west pond are full of mature fish for catch and release fishing. Varieties of fish include Channel Cats, Sunfish and Bass so bring your fishing gear for an afternoon of pleasure and relaxation. We sell bait in our store. Please Note: For those fishing at Maple Leaf Conservation down the road and staying with us, we do not allow the cleaning of fish in our Restroom/Showerhouse or anywhere on our property. The Meeting Room will easily seat up to 50 people. It would be a great place to hold meetings, Group Get-Togethers, RV and Camping Clubs, Family Reunions, Baby Showers or whatever occasion you have
